title: SKYTTA stop bar
description: SKYTTA stop bar, 2 tracks, set of 2, white This stop bar is the perfect way to frame your SKYTTA sliding door solution and a smart solution if you cannot remove your skirting board. It is also practical and good looking! 1 package of stop bars is enough for 1 SKYTTA sliding door solution.
features: 2 stop bars included, 1 for each side of the sliding door solution.
When using a stop bar, the ceiling rail must cover the total width of the doors, including the stop bar on each side.
Possible to cut to correct height.
Fits perfectly with SKYTTA rails for sliding door, 2 tracks. Wider bars available for SKYTTA rails for sliding door, 3 tracks.
